helpGuide.title: How to use this app
helpGuide.s1Text: Tap Report a Problem. Choose the problem, add a photo, tell us the place, then tap Send Complaint.
helpGuide.s2Text: Tap Track My Complaint. Tap your complaint to see its status and photos.
helpGuide.s3Text: When your problem is fixed, look at the after photo. Tap Yes, Problem Solved and give stars. If it is not fixed, tap Not Solved.

tour.citizen1Text: This app helps you tell the Municipal Corporation about problems near you.
tour.citizen2Text: Tap here to tell us about a problem. It takes 4 short steps.
tour.citizen3Text: Tap here to see what is happening with your complaint.
tour.citizen4Text: Tap the Help button at any time to see how the app works.
